scope.name: Mannerheimintie actual track axes and source junction curves; Erottaja/Esplanadi to Finlandia, final play-bounds only
scope.selectionPolicy: A source railway=tram way must intersect final playable rectangle, have at least one source node within30m of a named Mannerheimintie highway axis, and all source nodes within40m. Keep whole source way/node ordering; actual rendering clips to bounds. No synthetic offset tracks and no automatic long cross-street expansion.

gauge.sourceTerm: Raideleveys; straight track1000mm. Each raidemetri contains two kiskometres.
gauge.limitation: Visual rail heads approximate groove/rail section; source geometry is track centreline, not surveyed individual steel edges.
